# RiskQuant Methodology Artefacts

This directory is intended for compact, version-controlled quantitative decision records when no stronger canonical methodology repository exists.

A methodology artefact is the source of truth only when explicitly marked `APPROVED` and linked to the relevant implementation/API scope.

Open design questions must be marked `OPEN`. Do not infer approval from an implementation that happens to exist.

Recommended naming:

`<domain>__<subject>__methodology.md`

Examples:

- `tail_risk__quantiles__methodology.md`
- `tail_risk__expected_shortfall__methodology.md`
- `dependence_stress__methodology.md`
- `sensitivity_pnl__taylor_expansion__methodology.md`
